deliverable: An on-chain escrow works like a neutral digital vault that holds the buyer's money until the seller delivers what was promised. Because the funds are locked in a smart contract, neither party can mess with them alone—both must follow the agreed rules for the money to be released. This lets strangers trade safely without needing to trust each other, since the escrow automatically enforces the deal.
